scope: Read-only bounded M3.3 frontend seam review; eight production grading modules plus AssessmentView, shared real journal, and session transport (11 production files). Existing unit and native tests read as coverage evidence, not rerun. CSS inventoried only.

findings.summary: Existing grading_revision>0 plus newly accepted regrade job failed/cancelled makes fresh-page explicit author recovery unavailable.
findings.cause: GET result returns terminal JobRef and no previous grading baseline; fallback is explicitly suppressed unless grading_revision is zero; Review begin has no baseline and remains disabled.
findings.provenance: Real React AssessmentResult/AssessmentReview/hooks plus real DraftStore/journal over fake-indexeddb; controlled HTTP replies match the current backend response contract. Not a native browser or actual HTTP test.
findings.existing_coverage_gap: Existing native lost-response test fails the regrade POST before an accepted job; it does not cover accepted job failure/cancellation after an old grade exists.

other_boundaries: No additional demonstrated residual issue in this bounded read. Result hook hides old identity/access synchronously and checks exact refs/max score; POST acknowledgements retain original command/epoch/value checks and suppress access-changed callbacks; journal CAS preserves conflicts; terminal/unknown scores are not coerced into zeros. This is not an exhaustive proof.
production_render_boundary: Shell keys AssessmentView by stable tab.id; distinct tabs remount. Artificial same-hook cross-tab rerenders were not asserted to be production reachable.
state: Root authorized repair after these preserved red observations; no reviewed frontend file edited by reviewer.
